tractor_small.name: Small Tractor (25–50 HP)
tractor_small.examples: Mahindra 275, John Deere 3028EN, TAFE 35DI, Sonalika DI-35
tractor_small.suitableFor: Small-medium farms (5–20 ha). Ploughing, harrowing, ridging, transport.

tractor_medium.name: Medium Tractor (50–80 HP)
tractor_medium.examples: Massey Ferguson 375, John Deere 5055E, New Holland TT55
tractor_medium.suitableFor: Medium-large farms (20–100 ha). Commercial farming, contract services.

tractor_large.name: Large Tractor (80–120+ HP)
tractor_large.examples: John Deere 6120M, Massey Ferguson 6713, Case IH Farmall 110A
tractor_large.suitableFor: Large commercial farms (100+ ha). Estate farming, sugarcane, wheat.

power_tiller.name: Power Tiller / Walking Tractor (8–15 HP)
power_tiller.examples: Kubota RT140, VST Shakti, Chinese two-wheel tractors
power_tiller.suitableFor: Smallholder farms (0.5–5 ha). Rice paddies, vegetable plots. Popular in Tanzania, Madagascar.

combine_harvester.name: Combine Harvester
combine_harvester.examples: John Deere S660, CLAAS Tucano, New Holland TC5060
combine_harvester.suitableFor: Large-scale wheat, rice, maize. South Africa, Egypt, Kenya Rift Valley.
